item.title: Meet Reginald Dotson, the Chef Behind Ash’Kara’s Excellent Mediterranean Food
item.description: There’s a stereotype of the hot-headed, highly-decorated chef that’s always screaming and terrorizing the kitchen team in order to achieve the perfect plate. But at the Michelin-recognized Ash’Kara in LoHi, executive chef Reginald Dotson couldn’t be farther from that image. “I’ve always been more of a deep thinker than a quick reactor,” Dotson shared. “That’s […] The post Meet Reginald Dotson, the Chef Behind Ash’Kara’s Excellent Mediterranean Food first appeared on DiningOut.
